changelog: The Retreat button gets its proper battle-worn plate, and in landscape the Retreat / How To Play / Replay Tips buttons now sit in a tidy row instead of each stacking full-width. The Bastion 'break the waves' mission finally shows an ornate WAVES counter in the HUD, matching the other objectives. Holding an objective is tougher now: if an enemy contests the point your progress resets to zero — secure it and start again. And single-objective missions (escort, escape, the hunt, the Spire) no longer clutter the HUD with a chip; the mission intro explains the goal.
